title: "Core-result tables"

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../../../../R/core/style.R")
source("../../../../R/core/spatial.R")
source("../../../../R/domains/kinematics.R")
source("../../../../R/figures/results/01-global-kinematics.R")
list2env(prepare_kinematics_data(), envir = environment())
list2env(prepare_results_kinematics_data(), envir = environment())
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
```

The main text reports the statistics that carry the argument. These tables
retain the associated design details and complete association matrix without
adding display items to the main article.

> 主文保留推进论证的数值；本页记录其空间检验设计和完整关联矩阵，便于核查。

::: {#tbl-supplementary-long-term-spatial-autocorrelation .list-table tbl-cap="Spatial-autocorrelation design for equal-area long-term warming fields."}

- - Statistic
  - Value
- - Spatial unit
  - Occupied 1° cells; lake-equal mean long-term Sen slope
- - Occupied cells
  - `r spatial_autocorrelation$n_cells`
- - Queen-neighbour pairs
  - `r spatial_autocorrelation$n_neighbour_pairs`
- - Moran’s I
  - `r fmt_num(spatial_autocorrelation$moran_i, 2)`
- - Two-sided permutation P
  - `r fmt_num(spatial_autocorrelation$permutation_p, 3)` (999 permutations)

:::
